police.name: Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department (Duarte Satellite Station)
police.snippet: The Duarte Satellite Station located at 1042 Huntington Drive is the launching center for 30 male and female officers that begin and end their shift here to provide Duarte, Bradbury and the unincorporated area west of Duarte with law enforcement services 24 hours a day.
